balls.text: 160 not happening in the end, Nayar swings and misses a full and wide one, appeal for caught behind turned down
gone, slower one does it, Pandey swings too early, loses off stump, and Smith remains off strike
walks across the stumps to a short ball and misses as it hurries down leg
Pandey gets it away this time, making room to a shortish ball and swatting it flat over extra cover
hit down to long off for only a single this time

phew, he's hitting them everywhere, this is an outrageous reverse pick up off the stumps that has disappeared over short third man, and well over the boundary, walks up to non-striker to punch the gloves hard, rarely seen this aggression from Smith
slow length ball, across the right-hander, who has a slog and misses
Pandey's dabbed this length ball towards third man, wide enough to be off strike for the next ove
missed out now, full toss across him, he;s timed the punch nicely again, but hit it straight to the sweepre
full and wide, but Smith reaches it with a stretch and slices it over point, and it rolls into the rope
and they didn't have playing till now, he walks across, takes an overpitched ball off leg stump and swings it all the way over deep backward square, best timing of the evening
walks outside off stump, Nannes follows him with one in the blockhole, he opens the face to run it to third man
full and wide, Pandey gets some bat on it and gets off strike as it rolls in front of point
width outside off, but it is the slower one, and Pandey can only help it as far as extra cover
Pandey makes room and swings, can't connect as the back of a length ball bounces over his bat
turns a length ball off middle and leg, straight to midwicket
hops and turns a back of a length ball off the pad behind square
and Pune lose another one now, Alblie gets into the game, short and wide, Marsh has slashed it towards third man, Albie is some way in, and he takes it over his head, and tumbles down with the effort
Smith gets something out of the over, picks a length ball angled in and slams it over wide long on
slower one, into the pads, he's waited and turned it past midwicket
comes forward and pushes a length ball to covers
guided to point for a quick run
first ball after the time out claims Taylor, it is short and wide, he reaches out to have a slog, and and sends it flat and straight to wide long on
Taylor is revving up that big slog, cannot get enough on this length ball angled in, it scoots along the ground to fine leg
into Taylor's pads, and he;s flicked it crisply wide of fine leg, but the man gets there with a sprint and a slide
cramped him for room totally, cut back in from back of a length, Taylor dropped it into the pitch, Smith eager to get the single, has to return
direct hit needed, not happening, Smith walks out and runs it to backward point, they go for one, Taylor had given up
gets on top of a shortish ball into the body and pulls it hard into the ground, splits the gap between fine leg and deep square, who both dive in vain
Smith advances out, tries to force a shortish one through off and gets a thick edge wide of the keeper
makes room outside leg, not much width, and he ends up chopping it towards point
beaten, sharp back of a length ball, Smith opens the face inside the line
full into the stumps, Taylor's flicked it behind square, and wide enough of fine leg to take two

almost gets into trouble first ball, walks across to a short of a length ball on the stumps, and misses, shout for lbw turned down, there is a direct hit from Dhoni but Smith is in, and he goes to the other end with the ricochet, given as runs, didn;t seem to be an inside edge, but it struck him really high, on the thigh pad
Uthappa has holed out to long on, went for the big lofted shot down the ground off this overpitched one, but he checked it a bit in the end, and long on does not have to move much
on the pads, but he cannot get much on it, short fine leg fields
leaves the crease again, is not to the pitch, and checks the lofted shot, it falls well short of long on
worked off the pad to deep square leg
Raina has dived at midwicket to stop the push, but he;s back flicked the throw way over the bowler, concedes another run
turns a flighted full ball past midwicket
Taylor spots a bit of width and cuts sharply, point cannot stop it cleanly
goes back and across to a length ball and works it to leg, Jadeja rushes to field
beaten first up as he stretches to drive outside off

guess who provides the breakthrough, Jadeja ends the partnership, Finch too quick to walk out, Jadeja straightens it off a length, it hits the pad and goes through to Dhoni, who has one of the easiest stumpings, with Finch stranded way out
Jadeja has fired it in flat and quick, but Finch is smoking 'em, he opens up quickly and dismisses it over deep midwicket
pushed down to long on
smashed straight to sweeper cover, Finch cross with himself for not putting it away
he flicks just over the man at midwicket this time, but there;s one at deep midwicket too
that hits the pads on the full down leg and runs fine, but short fine leg is able to cut it off
comes down the track, Ashwin pauses and pushes it through into the batsman, he is able to work it past midwicket
flicked straight to midwicket off pad
hops to a back of a length ball and takes the single as it dribbles square off the pad
drags a slowish bouncer over square leg
again he makes room outside leg, Morris follows him with an angled delivery, Finch still times the cut, but he's picked out point
he;s somehow managed to drill this over extra cover, he was backing away to leg, Morris bowled it wide outside off, Finch had to really stretch, he did alright
that;s hit him in the stomach as he misses the pull, Finch picks it up and gives it back to the bowler
slower length ball outside off, he drags a slog out to deep square leg
full and into the stumps now, Uthappa gets behind and pushes firmly down to long on
cuts in again, back of a length, punched to sweeper
overpitched, defended close to the crease
that did not get up that much outside off, good length, cut in too, Uthappa jabs at it, misses
short, wide, rather poor start, Uthappa gets the cut going in the air wide of point
Uthappa leans into a straight push, bowler takes pace off it, but the single is on
chops it wide of cover this time for one
tries the cut and misses a widish one
Finch is making the most of fine leg being up, he;s swivelled and gone hard at a shortish one, and the top edge has almost carried over the fine leg rope, that is also his fifty
hit on the pad as he misses a length ball, but that was headed down leg
pitched up outside off, he comes forward and pushes it wide of extra cover for one
gets inside the line, leaves the crease and checks the lofted stroke down to wide long off
stops before he releases the ball, Uthappa tries another reverse sweep, is hit on the pad outside off
pushed down to long off for a single
making slight room, it is overpitched outside off, and he cannot get under it, driven to sweeper cover
long off is in place, but he has no chance with this, Finch has cleared him comfortably
darted into the pads, good length, worked through square leg
reverse sweep, from a fullish length, but not enough legs in it to beat short third
right forward to defend to the off side close to the pitch
Finch continues to back away outside leg to Jadeja, but he finds the sweeper on the boundary this time
in the air for a while, but the push was wide enough of extra cover
spinning away from a good length, and cut away to the sweeper
still fuller, around middle and leg, and driven to long on
hits a flighted fullish ball to the bowler
pushed down to long on for one
fine leg is up, Ashwin has speared it wide down the pads, and Uthappa has helped it over the fielder with a sweep
goes across to an offbreak, turns it straight to midwicket
tossed up just outside off, he is forward to defend
played out on the off side
nice, that;s run into the long on boundary, Finch lifted a length ball over the man at mid on, didn;t time it too well, but it had enough in it
now he gets across to a back of a length ball and works it square to leg
he tries the short one at Uthappa, it takes off, and he ducks under safely
mistimes the pull this time, takes the single to forward square leg
Nannes getting the line wrong with the short ball, on the pads with fine leg up, bye bye ball, with a swivel and a pull behind square
turned wide of midwicket
tried backing away again, but Jadeja has darted it in real quick, and he has to jab it down the track
pushed back to the bowler
Finch makes room to Jadeja again, and carts a length delivery over cover-point
tosses it up slowly now around off, Finch forward to push to off
Jadeja offers width, and Finch punishes it with a cut past cover
nearly popped a length ball back to the bowler, Nannes staggered away to his right in his followthrough, else he had a good chance of taking it
appeal for lbw, but that was going easily outside off, and pitched outside leg too, could have been a run out, but throw misses at striker's end
beaten, walks down to push at one going across with the angle, ball moves in past inside edge
short into the body, and swung straight into Morkel at short fine leg, nearly carried to him
jumps across and tries to work one down the leg side, but misses
the delivery with which he gets so many wickets, sliding in with the angle, hits him on the pad on the forward defensive, not given, hit outside the line of off
quick and straightening on off, he comes across and works it down the pitch
stretches forward to defend in front of cover, Uthappa trots out, Finch shouts no
tossed up on a length now, pushed with an open face to point, and they go through for a sharp single
makes room outside leg to a flat and shortish ball and cracks it through extra cover
worked to midwicket
another attempted big drive through off, and another miss, Pune showing all the intent the benched captain Mathews has wanted them to
third boundary in the over, this time not in the direction he intended, tries to drive through off again, ball swings in, takes inside edge and disappears past short fine
goes hard again, and connects, lifting a length ball outside off high over mid off
full, wide and leaving him on the angle, he has a go at it and misses
that swung in again, but he flayed it straight down the ground,bat face closing as he went for the shot, but had enough in it to race down the pitch and beat mid on
swings in full on the stumps, patted softly to the off side for a single
he moves across this time, Dinda slows it down and Ashwin's heave produces one
full again, Ashwin backs away and swings, thick edge eludes the keeper on off
backs to leg again, Dinda follows him with a short one, Ashwin opens the face to lift it fine, but third man cuts off the boundary with a dive
low full toss around off, Ashwin's made room and steered it past short third man
Dinda hits the blockhole, Ashwin pats it back

and Morkel almost hits one off the first, hammers a full toss to long off, but this is Pune;s night, Finch times the leap and plucks it out of the air, Donald is right behind in the dugout and he;s delighted
ends with yet another full toss, it is powered to long on, couple of bounces
slow and wide now, he reaches out and drags it to the leg side close to the pitch, not happening for CSK today
can;t get under one more full toss, drilled down to long on
low full toss crashed down to long off, slight fumble and they are back for two
full and across, Morkel has a go, mishits it to the bowler
full toss flayed down to long off
outstanding over from Dinda, he's come back from that pasting he took in the last match. around the blockhole once more, dragged down the ground for one
yorker, outside off, Morris misses
full and wide, lofted over extra cover, long off runs around to reach it

Dinda's the man, for Pune Warriors, he;s taken out his India captain, overpitched, Dhoni tries getting under it, but does not succeed, it is drilled straight to Smith on the long off boundary, and Smith takes it and kicks it away once more,
nice, right in the blockhole, outside off, Dhoni forces it back, Dinda throws himself to his left to field
full and wide, flies off the bat on the bounce to the sweeper
tries a pull, an underedge rolls in front of long onf
there goes Morkel, slogs it high and mighty, it doesn;t look like coming down, doesn;t like having gone the distance, but it has, sails just over long on in the end
slow length ball, Albie cannot do anything with it
shortish and wide, Dhoni reaches and chops to point
flays a pitched up ball to long off along the ground
slow and around the blockhole, Dhoni adjusts to push it down to long on, has to settle for one
goes back and whips a good length legbreak to midwicket
Rahul strikes in his final over, Bravo wants to go down the ground, quick and full from the bowler, Bravo's mistimed it from close to the toe end to long off, looked awry the moment he hit it
reaches out and drives a full ball past the bowler to long off
under edges it past the keeper for a single, that was a tough chance
very close, that was slashed in the air, short third went for the catch with a dive forward, Nayar gets up and runs as the ball rolls behind, Bravo pushes Dhoni for the third, super running
there was width on the legbreak, but Dhoni, batting without a helmet now, chopped it into the pitch
beaten on a flash outside off as it cuts in from a good length
across to a length ball and gets a leading edge past the bowler's dive, extra cover fields
banged short and angled down the leg side
Jadeja;s given it away, Marsh back of a length on the pads, but Jadeja turns it straight to short fine leg
Dhoni forward to stab it in front of extra cover for a quick run
makes room outside leg, Marsh bowls it outside off, and he ends up hitting it off the toe end to long off
wide one, he dabs it in the air, but it falls short of third man up in the circle
forward to drive down to long off
quicker, Dhoni stays back and pushes softly to short extra
appeal for lbw, but that hit him full and was headed down leg
shortish, Jadeja short-arm pulls it through midwicket
Jadeja attacks the legspinne, length ball flighted around off, he gets front leg away and carts it into the sightscreen
dabs a pitched up legbreak to short third man
Badri goes, and the partnership is broken shy of 50, it was an offcutter, Badri made some room and went after it, ended up slicing it towards long off, Smith runs in and slides to complete the catch
clears front and swings, along the ground to long off
wide, but he bashes the cut straight to point
down the track and scythes it wide of the sweeper, sharp running to make it for the second
Jadeja bends on a knee and slogs, just over midwicket's jump, and gets the four early in the over
paddles from well outside off, cannot get any timing on it, to short fine leg
hit down to long on, Rahul with another tight over
skips out, takes it on the full, but cannot beat the bowler as he hits it hard down the pitch, Rahul getting down in time to stop it
missed out, short and turning into the pads, he pulls it on the bounce to short fine, and just makes it for the single
Badri bends the knee to swing it over midwicket, but gets it along the ground with an underedge
makes room outside leg, it is angled across him, and he slams it to sweeper cover
flays an overpitched ball to extra cover
two is the call straight away as Badri turns this through midwicket, and they make it back quite comfortably
widish, he chops it to cover
slow and full on the pads, Jadeja wristily turns it through square leg, wide of the man in the deep
hit down to long on off the inner half of the bat
Badri's lined this up, gentle length ball outside off, and he;s gone across, bent the knee and picked it cleanly to the deep midwicket rope
tries to clear front leg, but it is shortish and wide outside off, he reaches to slap it to point
short again, pulled through midwicket, long on cuts it off
goes across and turns it behind square leg
shortish, he makes room to cut wide of the sweeper from off stump
around the blockhole, Jadeja tries to go after it, but can only force it back to the bowler
flatter, full again, pushed to sweeper cover for one
floated up full, he reaches out to push to extra cover
tight over from Nayar, Jadeja can;t get much on the push to a length ball, and Nayar runs forward to field close to the pitch on off
very full on middle and leg, he manages to move across and nudge it to short fine
pushes a length ball but straight to point
whips a length ball off pad past midwicket
in the blockhole from Nayar, Jadeja digs it out
squeezed a wide one past point;s dive, third man gets around
forward to push to sweeper cover
short, sitting up, and Badri pulls it to the deep midwicket rope
turned with the spin through midwicket, but the man from the deep runs in and keeps them to one
low full toss turned off the pad to deep midwicket
reaches out to a tossed up ball and pushes it, extra cover dives and parries it towards the bowler
full toss first up, punched wide of the sweeper
thick inside edge past the stumps as he goes pushing outside off
lovely placement, Badri timing the steer past a diving point and also beating the sweeper

Taylor takes it at extra cover, Nayar gets Vijay, who had started to time them, he went for a hoick to a length ball, probably trying to make the most of the part-timer, top edge swirled straight up and Taylor managed to cling on
stayed a touch low as it came in from a length, and Vijay swung above the line
gentle length ball wide outside off, he cannot pick the gap between short third and backward point
length ball swatted wide of long off, he gets there in time, and Badri has enough speed to make it back for the second, as replays confirm after an appeal for run out
turned to midwicket
now he's tried to pull a length ball, timed it too, but midwicket is in the way
Suman has taken a catch, but the one he's not taken is hurting Pune now, Vijay's stood in the crease and sent a length ball some way over the long on boundary
stretches forward to drive a pitched up ball, wide of mid off
Marsh angles it into the pads, and Badri wristily turns it to the fine leg rope
comes forward to run a length ball to third man
forward to push to cover, Bhuvi's given nothing away
punched to Smith at point
turned to square leg
trier he sure is, Dinda, he saves four here at with a sprawling dive at third man, it takes him some way from the ball, he recovers quickly to throw it back, Badri had timed the steer quite well
another chance at mid on, and this has been taken, Suman it is again, Raina going for the heave over the leg side, ended up mishitting it tamely in front of Suman, who slid forward to take it low
brings bat around front pad to turn a length ball to mid on
comes forward nicely and opens the face late to send it to third man
looks to loft it over covers but ends up slicing to third man
Taylor has banged his right knee into the ground trying to slide across from short fine leg, Dinda moved it into the pads and Vijay turned it wide of TAylor, who is in some discomfort
into the pads again, and Vijay tickles it wide of short fin e leg for four more,
Vijay picks it high over square leg, Bhuvneshwawr runs around and stops it, but his foot has touched the rope
wants to swing it through midwicket, inside edge goes to keeper on the bounce, and Uthappa cannot collect
across to a good length ball just outside off and tucks it in front of square leg
jabs at a length ball and it runs down to third man
goes full and wide, but sprays it too far outside off
pitched up and wide, Vijay goes for the drive, but it is the slower one, and he has to check the shot to cover
cannot beat cover with the push, Mitch Marsh cannot field cleanly, but no single conceded
straightens on off stump from a good length, softly pushed to covers
good length, ending just outside off, turned to midwicket
not something that happens often, Raina moves across to a short ball and thumps a pull in front of square leg
dropped Suman has put down a sitter at mid on, Taylor can;t believe it, he does not know what expression to settle on, Vijay bashed a pull straight to Suman, catchable height, and he clanged it
short, around off, he lets it go
chopped into the boot and they take the single as it runs towards point
thick edge, as it straightens off a good length, down to third man
pushes a back of a length ball back to his UP team-mate
more width, from back of a length, this time he pushes at it, and is beaten
width outside off, but Raina chops the cut to point
another shout for lbw, this swung in as well, into the left-hander, replays show it pitched just outside leg

that is given, Bhuvneshwar doing it again early, he's swung it in a mile, from a good length, Anirudha caught on the back leg, in the crease, most umpires would give that, umpire Chaudhary slowly but surely raises the finger
moves in from a good length, he mistimes a push close to the pitch on off
